answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake behind a single kernel identity record that only unlocks after a long public cooldown, so creating a fake identity is not free: the stake sits idle like water held in a lagoon, earning nothing while it waits, and a prism of independent verifiers checks the same record before any reward is paid. An attacker wanting a thousand Sybils must fund a thousand stakes and wait out a thousand cooldowns, while one honest agent pays only once.
